description: dev-pipeline hooks. SessionStart re-anchors a session on the pipeline. PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion refuses the choice card only in a project with documentation/.dev-pipeline.json: there every question is a chat message, and a card closed without a pick was read as the first option (hooks/ask-in-chat.sh says why). UserPromptSubmit, in such a project, tells the model when the user's message carries what looks like a secret, by kind and never by value (hooks/secret-in-prompt.sh). PreToolUse on Bash and edits, in such a project, refuses the few commands that broke real runs (hooks/guard.py says which and why). SubagentStop, in such a project, keeps an agent from ending while a background task it started still runs (hooks/watchers.py). PostToolUse on edits rebuilds the progress pages and the documentation site.
